title: The impact of PDD during TURB for NMIBC: a prospective randomized controlled trial
official: The impact of PDD during TURB for NMIBC: a prospective randomized controlled trial
summary: Primary objective is to compare the completeness of TURB with PDD vs TURB with WL in terms of proportion of patients with residual disease and/or upstaging at re-TURB.

interventions.name: Hexvix 85 mg polvere e solvente per soluzione endovescicale

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Voluntarily signed informed consent per Good Clinical Practice and national regulations
2. Age ≥ 18 years
3. Patient planned for TURB for >1,5 cm suspected (with either abdomen ultrasound or flexible cystoscopy) primary bladder cancer. The cut-off of 1,5cm has been chosen to maximize the probability of enrolling high-risk patients and, consequently, to maximize the probability of performing the re-TURB.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with history of recurrent NMIBC
2. Patients with visible incomplete resection during primary TURB.
3. Patients with metastatic disease or with a preoperative CT scan highly suspected for MIBC.
4. Allergy to hexaminolevulinate hydrochloride or any of the ingredients listed in Smpc of the product.
5. Previous diagnosis of porphyria.
6. Diagnosis of from gross haematuria or blood in the urine.
7. Diagnosis of bladder inflammation, a recent urinary tract infection.
8. Pregnancy and breastfeeding
